description: This line plot illustrates the training loss evolution over iterations for five different model configurations, comparing a baseline “Vanilla” model with several variants of the “SepLLM” architecture. The x-axis, labeled “#Iteration,” spans from 0 to 140,000 iterations on a linear scale, with tick marks appearing at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot includes five distinct lines: the “Vanilla” model is represented by a purple line with circular markers and a solid line; “StrmLLM (n=64)” is shown as a blue line with circular markers and a solid line; “SepLLM (n=64)” is an orange line with circular markers and a solid line; “SepLLM (n=64, H)” is a green line with circular markers and a solid line; and “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” is a red line with circular markers and a solid line. The “SepLLM (n=128)” variant is depicted as a dark blue line with circular markers and a solid line. All lines begin at a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a rapid initial decline, followed by a slower, more gradual decrease toward a stable loss value near 2.5 after approximately 100,000 iterations. The “Vanilla” model starts at a loss of approximately 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.5. The “StrmLLM (n=64)” model starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.7. The “SepLLM (n=64)” model starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at approximately 2.5. The “SepLLM (n=64, H)” model starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at approximately 2.5. The “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” model starts at approximately 3.3 and ends at approximately 2.5. The “SepLLM (n=128)” model starts at approximately 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.5. All lines show a consistent downward trend with minimal fluctuation after the initial phase.
